requirements.text: reconcile_codex_research_merges.verify_merged_pr only accepts a merged GitHub PR whose head ref equals the transition branch. Several governed fixes were landed as direct fresh-main replacement commits and their PRs closed unmerged, so the tasks stay IN_REMEDIATION or CODEX_READY indefinitely and invite duplicate Codex work. Add a bounded, evidence-bearing path for this case (for example a direct-landing receipt that binds the main commit SHA, the superseded PR number and a recorded equivalence to the transition branch head or the task's allowed scope), feeding the existing POST_FIX_OBSERVATION/completion flow. Never mark RESOLVED without the task's post-fix gate.
A direct-landing receipt bound to a main commit moves the task to POST_FIX_OBSERVATION, never directly to RESOLVED.
The existing PR-merge path is unchanged.
A receipt naming a commit not on main is rejected.
A receipt without post-fix gate evidence cannot produce RESOLVED.
No existing merge or completion receipt is rewritten.
